dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Do you have any special commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: I didn't expect you to come to the Adventurers' Guild, Miss Jahoda. Hehe, let me guess... Lady Nefer asked you to come by and pick up the latest weat{RUBY#[D]Fatui deployment log}her records?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Tch, stop acting like you can tell what everyone wants without asking. That's so annoying. If you've got it, just hand it over quickly. Boss Nef wants to see if there will be a snow{RUBY#[D]large-scale operation}storm in the coming days.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: No need to be impatient, Miss Jahoda. W{RUBY#[D]the Snezhnograd Veche}e can't decide when the snow will fall. But like you, we don't want to see such terrible weather either.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: I'll arrange for an adventurer to deliver the weather records that Lady Nefer needs. Have a pleasant day ahead, Miss Jahoda.
